title: Detector input size (512 vs 640)
criterion_preregistered: The D-FINE TB-lesion detector input size is chosen between 512 and 640 by development AP at IoU 0.50 (methodology section 7), computed with p3_det.metrics.ap50 (pycocotools-equivalent, full 512-image coordinates, all original ground-truth boxes, D21) on each run's FINAL-epoch EMA weights. Both runs use configs identical except input size (same schedule hash: seed, epochs, batch size, learning rates, augmentation) and the LOCKED D08/D09 preprocessing; runs on provisional preprocessing are not eligible. The size with the higher point estimate is kept; an exact tie keeps 512 (native TBX11K resolution). 95% CIs: percentile bootstrap over development images, stratified TB/non-TB, B and seed from D21 (default B=2000, seed 0); the paired bootstrap CI of AP50(640) - AP50(512) is reported and does not change the rule. Contingency: if the chosen size has development AP50 < 0.05, D16 is not locked, tuning stops, and the detector contingency is raised with P4 (negative result reported, link rule disabled, Grad-CAM as the main localisation evidence).
